Nvidia to Invest Up To $3 Billion in Data Center Developer Lancium

Chip-maker Nvidia plans to invest up to $3 billion in Lancium, a developer of data centers. The initial investment will be $2 billion for approximately a 20% stake in the power infrastructure company. This information was reported by The Information.
